title: Skill authoring patterns
purpose: Static cues for /better-skill coach only; not injected by hooks. Domain-neutral; no adaptive corpus.

subagents.pattern: Orchestrator MUST NOT one-shot heavy slices; one Task/subprocess per slice with written brief; merge to durable artifact; cap parallel passes.
subagents.antiPattern: Single chat completion claims ledger + emit + verify done without subprocess boundaries.

validation_done.pattern: Each phase or run ends with observable done: verifier exit 0, validation_log step, or explicit STOP with operator recovery.
validation_done.antiPattern: Looks complete or should work with no command, exit code, or STOP table.

verification_schema.pattern: Durable JSON: schema_version, contract doc, forbidden inputs, proceed means fresh run not merge failed attempt.
verification_schema.antiPattern: Retry same path without logging blocked assumption; durable paths containing /temp/.

iterative_subsets.pattern: Large work via phased gates, map_only or per-bundle temp files; delete temp/ before complete.
iterative_subsets.antiPattern: Materialize full artifact and markdown in one turn without subset boundaries.
